verdict.rationale: Baseten's docs explicitly document SSE token-by-token streaming ('Return model output token by token as it is generated' / 'Streaming sends tokens as they are generated over server-sent events, which suits long generations and UIs where partial output beats a blank wait'), directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer confirmation of streaming latency in practice and code samples showing client-side SSE consumption.
